title: Framework-neutral lake research contract
scientific_baseline: Frozen report 2026-10-26 plus documented derived spatial extensions; scientific assets are not rewritten by this contract.
important: These are published research extracts and derived products, NOT a complete archive of upstream raw satellite bands, station records or field measurements.

layers.derived_spatial: Sourced geometry, classified footprints or derived terrain

global_rules: Never infer water level/depth from area or visual water material.
Monthly water classification, daily imagery, seasonal NDVI, annual rainfall, GHSL epochs and climatology are distinct clocks.
No quality-qualified data means missing, not dry, safe or zero.
Approximate anchors and candidate lines are not surveyed culverts, flow paths or property boundaries.
Regional meteorology is not a field-scale wind/rain interpolation.
Retain source attribution and independent rights review for public reuse.

GHSL区域屋顶覆盖总量，不是单栋楼高或逐像元城市变化。
原模块无配图；治理/水库时间线可重绘为叙事，不能称恢复原始地图。
行政区面雨量与POWER格点分列，只有1985–2022可同年配对，不能空间插值成湖边实测。
56像元、55共同像元、52个JJA水面样本和59个JJAS主样本须分开。
